question: How do I configure the package name and client class name when publishing a Python SDK to PyPI using Fern?
ground_truth: To configure the package name and client class name when publishing to PyPI, you need to update your generators.yml file. Set the output location to 'pypi', add a unique package-name under the output section, and configure the client_class_name under the config section. The client class name must be in PascalCase and is the name customers will use to import your SDK.

metadata.cited_context:
In the `group` for your Python SDK, change the output location in from `local-file-system` (the default) to `pypi` to indicate that Fern should publish your package directly to the PyPi registry. Your package name must be unique in the PyPI repository, otherwise publishing your SDK to PyPI will fail. The `client-class-name` option controls the name of the generated client. This is the name customers use to import your SDK (`import {{ your-client-name }} from 'your-package-name';`). 

```yaml title="generators.yml"
groups: 
  python-sdk:
    generators:
      - name: fernapi/fern-python-sdk
        version: 4.32.3-rc1
        output:
          location: pypi
          package-name: your-package-name
        config:
          client_class_name: YourClientName # must be PascalCase
```
